arguments.label: Inspect users.json
arguments.command: cd /workspace/task && ls -la scratch/ && cat scratch/users.json && md5sum scratch/users.json

cd /workspace/task && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
d=json.load(open('scratch/users.json',encoding='utf-8'))
names=sorted(u['name'] for u in d if u.get('enabled') is True)
json.dump(names,open('scratch/enabled.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
json.dump({"file":"enabled.json","count":len(names)},open('scratch/manifest.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
EOF
cat scratch/enabled.json scratch/manifest.json; md5sum scratch/users.json
